plugin.description:
Suppresses the large on-screen countdown overlay produced by the /countdown command. The countdown still runs and fires normally — only the visual is hidden.

Commands:
/cdhide — toggle the feature on/off
/cdhide config — open settings
plugin.summary: Hides the on-screen visual when using the in-game /countdown.
